findings.title: Per-line grid opacity checks both axis styles instead of the line's own axis.
findings.body: `grid_alpha` returns the default 0.4 opacity for a line with its own color only when neither axis has a `GridLinesStyle`. Now that x and y can be styled separately, the closure is shared by both axes but checks both slots. Example: `GridLinesStyle -> {Automatic, Directive[Red]}` with `GridLines -> {{{2, Blue}}, Automatic}`. The x axis has no style, but its blue line is drawn fully opaque at 1.0 because the y axis is styled. The fix is to pass the axis's own style slot into `grid_alpha`: `.0` for vertical lines and `.1` for horizontal lines.
